book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke booŋ be ba ŋgoo le mbebe mamasi le
Ajiŋ ayu Jiso ka wu dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke booŋ be ba ŋgoo le mbebe Mamasi wù Tibɛlia le. Fi gɛ̀ kooshi a yinɛ je le:
Samoŋ Bita bɛ Toma wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Amaŋ, mo Natanya wu Kana kimbe kì Galalee le, mo booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi lɛ, mo booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso bamu bafɛɛ gɛ̀ bee kijusɛ kimimia.
Samoŋ Bita ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Nlade bíɛŋ.” Bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Besabɛŋ le be la.” Bɛ bo mo bo bu bo gɛɛŋ bo lee a ŋguh le. Geenɛ, bo jiɛnyɛ bo che a joo bo gɛ koo fiɛɛ gɛ.
Lɛ akfuuŋ kɛ a yuude a too, Jiso to wu lɛɛŋ ŋgɛɛmɛ yi joo le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ lɛ le wu gɛ.
Jiso biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Booŋ baŋ, bɛŋ le bɛŋ koo gɛh bíɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Aay.”
Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ noŋ gwii je kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki ŋguh le bɛŋ lé bɛŋ kôo fiɛɛ.”

content: Bo mo bo noŋ, wu tu wu yage bo ki bo chii, nje bo gɛ̀ koo bíɛŋ yo wesee.

Mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wɛɛ wù Jiso gɛ̀ koŋe doo wu yɛŋ noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ Bita le lɛ, “Le Tada.” No Samoŋ Bita yu lɛ le Tada, wu mo wu jii njú ye ye le, nje wu gɛ̀ bee ye yi yɛse. No wu jile njú ye noo wu mo wu selɛ a joo wu tu wu gɛɛne fɛ Jiso le.
Geenɛ, booŋ ba ŋgoo bamu baa tu bo bii a ŋguh le bo chiide gwii kwɛɛ wù nyu wu yisɛ bɛ bíɛŋ. Gɛ bo gɛ̀ baaŋ je yì ndefe le fɛ bo bu kwa gɛ. Bantaŋ gɛ̀ shɛɛ wa njɛ ŋkɛŋɛ mbaanshɛŋ.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo fɛsɛ kwa bo yɛŋ ŋgu le wu keede lo yi bika le, bíɛŋ nyu yu, blɛd nyu tɛ fo.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ to bɛ bíɛŋ yimi yì bɛŋ kole.”

content: Noo Samoŋ Bita gɛɛŋ wu bɛɛŋ a ŋguh le wu chii gwii wu bu kwa wù nyu wu yisɛ bɛ bíɛŋ yì kuge yi gɛ̀ bee gwii kicho mbaanshɛŋ ncho yishɛde (153). No yi gɛ̀ bee wesee nɛ, gwii gɛ̀ baaŋ saayɛ gɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,
Muh wu mumwaa booŋ be ba ŋgoo le gɛ̀ baaŋ moŋ gɛ wu biih wu le laa le wu wù yɛɛŋ lɛ. Bo gɛ̀ kee lo lɛ le Tada.
Jiso mo wu gɛɛŋ wu jo blɛd wɛɛ wu nya bo le mo bíɛŋ chiɛɛ fo.
Finɛ gɛ̀ bee wa kiŋgane kintɛde no Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke booŋ be ba ŋgoo le kɛge no wu gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le.
Jiso kaasɛ wu nya lɛme Bita le
Bo gɛ̀ ji mwɛɛ bo mɛsɛ, Jiso bɛɛŋ Bita wu biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Samoŋ mwa Joŋ, wo koŋe mɛ wo fede bamu banɛ?”

content: Wu chvuu lɛ, “Ɛɛŋ Tada, wo kee lo lɛ ŋkoŋe wo.” Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Jiso ka wu bɛɛŋ wu ki kiŋgane kinfɛɛ wu biih wu le lɛ,
Wu chvuu lɛ, “Ɛɛŋ Tada, wo kee lo lɛ ŋkoŋe wo.” Wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Jiso ka wu bɛɛŋ wu ki kiŋgane kintɛde wu biih wu le lɛ,
Bita yu no Jiso biide wu le kiŋgane kintɛde laa wu koŋe wu la, fi fuuŋsɛ lo wu. Wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, wo kee mwɛɛ munchii, wo kee lo lɛ ŋkoŋe wo.” Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, sege wo gɛ̀ baaŋ chumu, le wo wù gɛ̀ jiide njú yo wo gɛɛne fɛ wo koŋe fo. Geenɛ, sege wo juŋ wa wo le wo chîaasɛ lo chiaaŋ we muh mu jii njú ye yo le, wu jô wo wu gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛ wo fɛ wo koŋe gɛ ki wo gɛ̂ɛŋ fo gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme finɛ wu duunyi nyu kfuu chi kwe yi Bita gɛ̀ bee ki wu gê wu kwe, yi to bɛ jee chì kuge fɛ Nyo le. No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

Bita doo wu kaasɛ ye wu yɛŋ mwa ŋgoo wɛɛ wù Jiso gɛ̀ koŋe le wu bii wu le. Mwa ŋgoo wunɛ le wu, wù gɛ̀ yɛmɛ wu gɛɛŋ yi Jiso le sege bɛ bo gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ fɛnfu yi kimɛsɛ le, wu biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, le yɛɛŋ wù lé wu gê wu gêsɛ wo?”
No Bita yɛŋ no mwa ŋgoo wɛɛ bii bo le, wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, fi muh wunɛ le lɛ la?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ fi le lɛ mbe ŋkoŋe lɛ wu mɛ gɛh wù nyu fɛnɛ gɛɛne bude no nlé ŋgê ŋkâasɛ nto, fifiɛɛ kɛ̂me la ki fi gê bɛ wo? Wo bîi mɛne.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, njɛmɛ mo wu gɛɛŋ antɛnɛɛ a bamii ba mbɛmɛ le lɛ, gɛ mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wunɛ nyu wu ge wu kwe gɛ. Geenɛ, Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ du gɛ lɛ gɛ wu nyu wu ge wu kwe gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ gɛh lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ fi le lɛ mbe ŋgoone lɛ wu mɛ gɛh wu nyume gɛɛne bude no nlé ŋgê ŋkâasɛ ntô, fifiɛɛ kɛme la ki fi gê bɛ wo.”

content: Kune muh wu saŋ ŋwa wunɛ
Mwa ŋgoo wuyu wunɛ wù jɛme kune mwɛɛ munɛ, le wu wù saŋ mwɛɛ munɛ, bee kee lo lɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme kune fi le nchiɛɛŋ.
Mwɛɛ mumu le tɛ yu wesee mù Jiso gɛ̀ ge, bee lɛ ba saŋ munchii, n'yɛnɛ lɛ gɛ kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ kichii taŋlo ki kɛmɛ fɛ ba gɛɛ baŋwa baa fo gɛ.
